quotes.text: keep the naming of the files the same

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When adding a Fluent file for an existing UI document, use the local file stem pattern so the pair is easy to find and package. The spam log Fluent file became spamLog.ftl to match the camel case naming in that UI area. A global dashed filename rule would be wrong here.
title: Match related UI resource file stems
